headline: World Bank: Romania carries out the most ambitious fiscal adjustment in Europe and Central Asia
summary: An updated World Bank report on economic prospects in Europe and Central Asia says Romania is undertaking the most ambitious fiscal adjustment in the region.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose regional economic outlooks inform investor views on government deficits, borrowing and sovereign risk.
